theory.intro: To convert negative indices to positive indices, a factor with a negative index crosses the fraction line and its index turns positive. To convert a positive-index denominator factor to negative-index form, move it to the numerator and make its index negative. Everything else stays where it is. Bases with negative indices must be non-zero; a negative power of zero is undefined.
facts: $a^{-n}=\frac{1}{a^{n}}$ and $ba^{-n}=\frac{b}{a^{n}}$: a factor with a negative index moves down, and only that factor moves.
$\frac{1}{a^{-n}}=a^{n}$ and $\frac{b}{a^{-n}}=ba^{n}$: a factor with a negative index in the denominator moves up.
A coefficient is only part of the base when brackets say so: $3m^{-4}=\frac{3}{m^{4}}$ but $(3m)^{-4}=\frac{1}{3^{4}m^{4}}=\frac{1}{81m^{4}}$.
Factors whose indices are already positive do not move: $p^{7}q^{-2}=\frac{p^{7}}{q^{2}}$.
A minus sign in front belongs to the coefficient, not the base, so it stays in front: $-2x^{-4}=-\frac{2}{x^{4}}$.
Going the other way, a factor leaves the denominator by making its index negative: $\frac{7}{a^{3}}=7a^{-3}$.
steps: For conversion to positive indices, identify which factors carry a negative index.
Move each of those factors across the fraction line.
Make each moved index positive and leave every other factor where it is.
For conversion to negative-index form, move each required positive-index denominator factor to the numerator and make its index negative, leaving every other factor where it is.

workedExamples.question_text: Rewrite $5a^{-4}b^{-2}$ with positive indices. Assume all variables are non-zero.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Only the factors with negative indices move to the denominator; the coefficient stays.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}5a^{-4}b^{-2}\\&=5\times\frac{1}{a^{4}}\times\frac{1}{b^{2}}\\&=\frac{5}{a^{4}b^{2}}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: Rewrite $6r^{5}s^{-4}$ with positive indices. Assume all variables are non-zero.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The $r^{5}$ already has a positive index, so it stays in the numerator.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}6r^{5}s^{-4}\\&=6r^{5}\times\frac{1}{s^{4}}\\&=\frac{6r^{5}}{s^{4}}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: Rewrite $\frac{8}{p^{-3}q^{2}}$ with positive indices. Assume all variables are non-zero.
workedExamples.solution_text:
Only $p^{-3}$ moves up; $q^{2}$ stays in the denominator.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\frac{8}{p^{-3}q^{2}}\\&=\frac{8}{q^{2}}\div\frac{1}{p^{3}}\\&=\frac{8}{q^{2}}\times p^{3}\\&=\frac{8p^{3}}{q^{2}}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: Write $\frac{5r^{2}t^{3}}{12s^{4}}$ as a single term whose only fraction is its coefficient, using a negative index where needed. Assume all variables are non-zero.

workedExamples.solution_text:
The index applies only to $z$, so the coefficient $-5$ stays.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}-5z^{-4}\\&=-5\times\frac{1}{z^{4}}\\&=-\frac{5}{z^{4}}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text:
Rewrite each expression with positive indices and no brackets. Assume all variables are non-zero.
(a) $(5m)^{-2}$
(b) $r(st)^{-2}$
(c) $(-2uv)^{-3}$
workedExamples.solution_text:
The reciprocal applies to the whole bracketed base. Each factor inside the brackets receives the positive power.
(a)
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(5m)^{-2}\\&=\frac{1}{(5m)^{2}}\\&=\frac{1}{5^{2}m^{2}}\\&=\frac{1}{25m^{2}}\end{aligned}$
(b)
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}r(st)^{-2}\\&=r\times\frac{1}{(st)^{2}}\\&=\frac{r}{s^{2}t^{2}}\end{aligned}$
(c)
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(-2uv)^{-3}\\&=\frac{1}{(-2uv)^{3}}\\&=\frac{1}{(-2)^{3}u^{3}v^{3}}\\&=-\frac{1}{8u^{3}v^{3}}\end{aligned}$

The $7$ has no negative index, so it stays in the denominator.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\frac{r^{-4}}{7}\\&=\frac{1}{r^{4}}\div7\\&=\frac{1}{7r^{4}}\end{aligned}$

workedExamples.question_text: Rewrite $\frac{7a^{3}c^{-2}}{8b^{-4}d}$ with positive indices. Assume all variables are non-zero.
workedExamples.solution_text:
The $c^{-2}$ moves down and the $b^{-4}$ moves up. All other factors stay.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\frac{7a^{3}c^{-2}}{8b^{-4}d}\\&=\frac{7a^{3}}{8d}\times\frac{1}{c^{2}}\div\frac{1}{b^{4}}\\&=\frac{7a^{3}}{8dc^{2}}\times b^{4}\\&=\frac{7a^{3}b^{4}}{8c^{2}d}\end{aligned}$

foundation.question_text: Write $\frac{1}{x^{6}}$ in index form with a negative index and no fraction line.
Rewrite $(2x)^{-2}$ with positive indices and no brackets.

development.question_text: Rewrite $(3m)^{-4}$ with positive indices and no brackets.
Rewrite $x(yz)^{-3}$ with positive indices and no brackets.
Write $\frac{4m^{3}}{n^{3}}$ as a single term with no fraction line, using a negative index.
Rewrite $(-x)^{-3}$ with positive indices and no brackets.

mastery.solution_text:
$\frac{5a^{2}c^{-4}}{6b^{-2}d}$
Only $c^{-4}$ and $b^{-2}$ carry negative indices, so only those two factors move.
$=\frac{5a^{2}}{6c^{4}d}\times\frac{b^{2}}{1}$
$=\frac{5a^{2}b^{2}}{6c^{4}d}$

$\frac{2a^{-4}}{b^{-5}c^{2}}$
The $a^{-4}$ moves down and the $b^{-5}$ moves up; the $2$ and the $c^{2}$ stay.
$=\frac{2}{a^{4}c^{2}}\times\frac{b^{5}}{1}$
$=\frac{2b^{5}}{a^{4}c^{2}}$
